title: Foo Bar Taxi Materialized Views
description: Create materialized views over a 3M-row NYC taxi trips table to pre-aggregate for common dashboard queries: hourly trip counts, daily revenue by taxi type, and fare distribution buckets.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must create materialized views that pre-aggregate a 3M-row taxi trips table to speed up dashboard queries from seconds to under 50ms.

tasks.description: Create materialized views for hourly trip counts, daily revenue by taxi type, and fare distribution buckets over analytics.taxi_trips.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw staging tables and a naive analytics.taxi_trips table (ORDER BY tuple()) with ~3M rows of yellow taxi data.
